text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: release/1.18.0 -> production starting in 20m. PR: https://gh.redwood/repo/pulls/4223 :rocket:

marta: Hold — did the security gate run for the release artifacts?

sec-scan-bot: Security gate report available. Status: FAILED.
- SBOM: generated (sbom-1.18.0.json)
- Vulnerability scan: new HIGH/CRITICAL findings

sec-scan-bot: ```
CRITICAL: package foo@1.2.3 -> CVE-2025-1234 (RCE)
HIGH: package bar@4.5.6 -> CVE-2024-9987 (DoS)
Summary: 1 critical, 2 high, 4 medium
Action: block-release
```

ken: tagging for security review. @marta @ryan please pause the rollout. We should not release with CVE-2025-1234.

ryan: Acknowledged. Reverting the release tag and pinning foo to 1.2.4 (patched) on the branch. Will push a hotfix branch now.

marta: ETA for patch + rescan? Also attach SBOM and grype output so CISO can sign off.

ryan: Working on it. Commands I'm running: ```
 git checkout -b hotfix/pin-foo-1.2.4 release/1.18.0
 yarn install && yarn build && docker build -t redwood/release:1.18.0-hotfix .
 ./tools/scan/grype --sbom sbom-1.18.0.json redwood/release:1.18.0-hotfix
```

secops: Uploaded SBOM: https://s3.redwood/sboms/sbom-1.18.0-hotfix.json
Here's the snippet of the SBOM package entry: ```
{"name":"foo","version":"1.2.4","purl":"pkg:npm/foo@1.2.4"}
```

sre-jen: Heads up — change window is 02:00-04:00 UTC. If we slip past the window we'll need a manual exception and notify product. Any rollback plan?

carol: I will prepare a rollback runbook — tagging canary routes, db feature flag revert steps, and smoke-tests. ETA 15m.

ryan: Rebuild complete, pushed image, re-running scan.

sec-scan-bot: Re-scan complete. Status: PASSED.
- No critical vulns. 1 high (bar@4.5.6) flagged but within acceptable policy with mitigation in play.

sec-scan-bot: ```
PASS: redwood/release:1.18.0-hotfix
Vulnerabilities: 0 critical, 1 high, 3 medium
Policy: allow-high-with-mitigation (requires sec lead ack)
```

ken: I reviewed the SBOM and scan. I approve the release to proceed with the hotfix image, provided the mitigation for bar (rate-limit config) is documented in the release notes and telemetry alerts are added. :white_check_mark:

marta: Adding mitigation notes and telemetry tasks to the release notes. Also pinning the model-serving image tag to avoid auto-latest drift.

deploy-bot: Hold lifted. Deploy scheduled in 5m with canary=10%, rollout=30m, auto-rollback on error>3% or latency>2x baseline.

carol: Rollback runbook uploaded: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/rollback-1.18.0. Includes commands, affected services list, and revert PR link.

sre-jen: Monitoring hooks ready. I'll watch canary for the next 45m. Ping me if anything looks off.

marta: Great work team. Note for postmortem: tighten SBOM generation for transitive deps (we missed bar's dependency chain).

deploy-bot: Deploy started. Logs: ```
[00:00] canary 10% -> success
[10:00] rollout 30% -> success
[20:00] rollout 60% -> success
[28:00] rollout 100% -> success
```

marta: :tada: Release complete. Closing security gate and marking release done.

ken: Thanks everyone. Filing a follow-up to add mandatory grype step to CI + SBOM checksum validation before release.

sec-scan-bot: Note: Audit record created: audit/1765004321-security-gate.json
